mentions.name: Fantasybook
mentions.description: A next-gen fantasy sports platform where managers buy and sell player shares like a stock market, featuring a full order book implementation. Users can create private leagues or join public ones, and a recently added Venture mode allows investing without a league to watch smart decisions pay dividends. It is for entertainment only.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://fantasybook.bet
A next-gen fantasy sports platform where managers buy/sell player shares like the stock market. Not just free-agent budget (FAB), we have a full order book implementation.
You can create private leagues or join a public one, and recently I added Venture mode where you can invest without a league to enjoy watching your smart decisions pay dividends. Fantasybook is for entertainment only as of now.
mentions.author: zygonfour
